messages:
alex: Heads-up — hitting a bug in python sdk where HTTP errors are raised as a plain Exception and the response payload/status are lost. Repro below.

alex: ```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=...)
try:
    client.generate("hi")
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e), e)
    # no status_code or response body accessible
```

maria: oof — can you share the server response? is it a 4xx with JSON body?

alex: 422 with body {"error": "validation failed", "field": "temperature"}. But exception message is just "Request failed" and no e.response or status_code.

jamal: Hmm this sounds like our HTTP layer wraps requests exceptions and reifies a generic SDKError but we didn't attach the response. @alex can you paste `pip freeze`? also which sdk version?

alex: redwood==0.9.1, requests==2.31.0

sdk-bot: Note — 0.9.2 has a patch for exception typing in the http layer but it might not include full response payload yet.

erin: We should add typed exceptions: `SDKHTTPError` (status_code, body, headers) and ensure async client raises the same classes. Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/issues/987

jamal: I'll pick this up. Plan: add SDKHTTPError that extends RedwoodError with `.status_code`, `.body`, `.headers` and preserve original `response` where possible. Also ensure `requests.exceptions.RequestException` keeps the `.response`. Will add unit + async integration tests. assigning to me.

alex: Temporary workaround: you can call the http client directly to inspect the raw response: 
```
resp = client._http.request("POST", "/v1/generate", json={...})
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```

maria: @jamal can we also make sure our retry/backoff layer doesn't swallow 4xx errors? validation errors shouldn't be retried.

jamal: good call — I'll mark 4xx as non-retriable and add an `.is_retryable` boolean to the exception so callers can programmatically decide. Also will add docs and CHANGELOG entry.

alex: also seeing failures when error body is plain text (not JSON) — need safe json parsing with raw-text fallback.

jamal: noted. timeline: small PR today for exception class + tests, review tomorrow, target release 0.9.3.

alex: :thumbsup: appreciate it.
